plugins.name: idea-queue
plugins.description: A side panel to queue ideas for later while a session works; send one on its own, or let the session work through them all

plugins.name: activity
plugins.description: A side panel of what the session is doing: tasks, background shells with their latest output, subagents nested with their own, running times and overall progress

plugins.name: command-runner
plugins.description: A Commands tab in the side panel: /run-command asks Claude to run something there, its output streams live and the tab stops it
